description:
Lexington Medical, Inc. is hiring an Electrical/Embedded Software Engineering Intern for Summer 2027 at our headquarters in Bedford, MA. You will join our R&D team and gain hands-on experience developing the embedded hardware and software behind our AEON™ surgical stapling platform. Depending on your background and project needs, your work may span electrical design, embedded firmware, PCB development, hardware bring-up, testing, debugging, and hardware-software integration.

About Lexington Medical

Lexington Medical, Inc. is a medical device company designing and manufacturing surgical stapling technology at our headquarters in Bedford, Massachusetts, just outside Boston. Our AEON™ Endostapler is an FDA-cleared, minimally invasive surgical stapler used in operating rooms around the world.

With electrical, software, mechanical, manufacturing, and quality teams working closely together under one roof, interns stay close to the product and see how engineering concepts move through development, prototyping, testing, verification, manufacturing, and ultimately into the operating room.

About the Internship

As an Electrical/ Embedded Software Engineering Intern at Lexington Medical, you will work alongside our R&D engineers developing embedded systems for electromechanical surgical devices. You will contribute to real engineering projects involving the interaction between electronics, embedded firmware, motors, sensors, and physical mechanisms.

Depending on your experience and interests, you may work more heavily on electrical hardware, embedded software, or projects that cross both areas. This could include designing and testing circuits, supporting PCB development, writing and debugging embedded code, bringing up new hardware, integrating sensors and motors, or troubleshooting complete electromechanical systems.

This is a good fit for a student who likes understanding how hardware and software work together and wants to build, test, debug, and improve real products rather than work only in simulation or theory.

Responsibilities: 

  • Support the development and testing of embedded electrical and software systems.
  • Develop, test, and debug embedded firmware using C/C++.
  • Assist with schematic capture, PCB design, and component selection.
  • Support hardware bring-up, bench testing, and system-level debugging.
  • Work with microcontrollers, sensors, motors, actuators, and other electromechanical components.
  • Use electrical test equipment to troubleshoot hardware and firmware.
  • Collaborate with electrical, software, mechanical, and manufacturing engineers.
  • Support engineering testing, verification, and technical documentation.

Qualifications: 

  • Currently pursuing a B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical field.
  • Coursework or project experience with embedded systems, electronics, microcontrollers, PCB design, firmware, or robotics.
  • Experience programming in C or C++.
  • Hands-on experience building, testing, or debugging hardware or embedded systems.
  • Prior internship, co-op, research, or substantial hands-on project experience preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and attention to detail.

What Success Looks Like

  • By the middle of the summer, you can contribute to day-to-day electrical and embedded software engineering work with increasing independence and understand how hardware, firmware, and electromechanical systems work together.
  • By the end of the internship, you have completed a meaningful electrical, embedded software, or hardware-software integration project that the engineering team can continue using after you leave.
  • You leave with concrete examples of hardware or firmware you developed, technical problems you solved, and engineering decisions you made on a real medical device.

Program Details

  • Timing: June 2027 through August 2027, approximately three months.
  • Schedule: Full-time, five days per week on-site in Bedford, Massachusetts.

Location & Work Arrangement

This internship is based at our headquarters in Bedford, Massachusetts, in the Greater Boston area, and is fully on-site five days per week.

Visit our Candidate Journey page to learn what to expect from our hiring process.

description:
Lightmatter is leading the revolution in AI data center infrastructure, enabling the next giant leaps in human progress. The company invented the world’s first 3D-stacked photonics engine, Passage™, capable of connecting thousands to millions of processors at the speed of light in extreme-scale data centers for the most advanced AI and HPC workloads.

Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter!

If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges, making an impact, and being an expert in your craft, join our team of brilliant scientists, engineers, and accomplished industry leaders.

Lightmatter is (re)inventing the future of computing with light!

The Photonics & Silicon Engineering team's core function is the design and development of Lightmatter's photonic processors and interconnects using light instead of electrical signals for computation and communication. They specialize in silicon photonics fabricating advanced optical components directly onto a silicon base to deliver chips and lasers with superior speed, low power and higher overall performance. The team's innovations are critical for eliminating data bottlenecks in next-generation AI and high-performance computing

Lightmatter is looking for a PhD candidate who can work in Photonics Characterization (Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related field) starting immediately with a strong understanding of Silicon Photonics and demonstrated experience in electro-optic testing of components like micro-rings and Mach-Zehnder interferometers. The ideal candidate will leverage hands-on laboratory experience with various optical and semiconductor test equipment, and be skilled in developing and implementing automated testing using Python scripting. This highly analytical, process-oriented individual must be capable of working independently to solve complex technical problems and translate data into actionable strategies.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in electro-optic testing of photonics chips/devices, leveraging hands-on laboratory experience and working with various optical instruments.
  • Conduct tests and characterization of silicon photonics components, including micro-rings, optical phase shifters, and Mach-Zehnder interferometers.
  • Operate a range of optical equipment such as lasers, electro-optic modulators, semiconductor optical amplifiers, PIN receivers, optical spectrum analyzers, optical vector analyzers, and optical filters.
  • Utilize semiconductor test equipment, including vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, source-meter units, arbitrary waveform generators, and high-speed oscilloscopes.
  • Design and execute testing protocols for silicon photonics chips and subsystems.
  • Develop and implement automated testing and system interfacing through Python scripting.

Qualifications

  • Recent PhD graduate OR PhD candidate in Photonics with a strong understanding of Silicon Photonics and demonstrated experience in electro-optic component testing.
  • Experienced in developing and implementing automated testing systems using Python scripting, with a proven ability to translate data into actionable strategies.
  • Highly analytical, process-oriented, and capable of working independently to solve complex, non-obvious technical problems in a lab environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

description:
Lightmatter is leading the revolution in AI data center infrastructure, enabling the next giant leaps in human progress. The company invented the world’s first 3D-stacked photonics engine, Passage™, capable of connecting thousands to millions of processors at the speed of light in extreme-scale data centers for the most advanced AI and HPC workloads.

Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter!

If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges, making an impact, and being an expert in your craft, join our team of brilliant scientists, engineers, and accomplished industry leaders.

Lightmatter is (re)inventing the future of computing with light!

The Packaging team at Lightmatter 

We are building the world's first photonic engine for AI at scale, and packaging is where the physics meets the product. Our Silicon Packaging team works at the intersection of electrical, mechanical, optical, and thermal engineering to bring co-packaged optics from concept to high-volume production.

We're hiring across all levels  from juniors undergrads to PhD candidates for both internship and full-time new grad positions. Wherever you are in your academic journey, you'll work on real problems from day one alongside engineers who have shipped leading-edge products at the world's most demanding semiconductor in the world. Why should you apply? To have the best and most interesting internship experience! Packaging at Lightmatter means working on co-packaged optics for the AI infrastructure that doesn't exist yet and helping build the team and methods that will make it real.

About NewsBreak

Founded in 2015, NewsBreak is the Content Intelligence platform shaping the future content economy. With over 40 million monthly active users, our flagship platform delivers highly personalized local news and information powered by advanced AI, recommendation systems, and adtech.

Recognized by Fast Company as #32 on the Top Workplaces for Innovators, we're proud to be Great Place to Work® certified and home to a dynamic team of technologists, product innovators, and business leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful challenges at scale.

Together, we reached unicorn status in 2021, and we remain committed to continuing this high-growth trajectory with the right team to fulfill our mission: building the infrastructure layer for content intelligence.

If you’re inspired to dream big, innovate fast, and make a difference, we’d love to hear from you! For more information, visit www.newsbreak.com/about

About Nearby.ai

Nearby.ai is a home services platform that connects homeowners with trusted local service providers — plumbers, electricians, cleaners, landscapers, HVAC technicians, and more. We're building the merchant network that makes that matching possible, and looking for a motivated intern to help drive that growth through local business outreach and partnership development.

About the Role

We're looking for an MBA-level Business Development & Strategy Intern to own a merchant-acquisition initiative end-to-end — from market research and territory selection, through self-sourced outreach and negotiation, to data-driven analysis and a final recommendation to leadership.

This is not a support role: you'll be measured on real business outcomes — partners signed, pipeline built, and insight generated — not just activity.

What You'll Own, End to End

Market and Territory Research

  • Independently map the local service-provider landscape in an assigned category or geography (for example, HVAC in a specific metro): merchant density, typical acquisition channels, and competitive platforms (Angi, Thumbtack, Yelp, etc.)
  • Size the opportunity and prioritize which merchant categories or neighborhoods to target first, using your own scoring framework

Self-Sourced Outreach and Pipeline Development

  • Build your own target list and reach out directly via phone, email, in-person visits, and social media — no inherited leads
  • Introduce Nearby.ai and pitch the value proposition to local business owners, handling objections yourself
  • Build and maintain a pipeline in a CRM or spreadsheet with real discipline: stage, next step, and expected close
  • Adjust your outreach approach based on the response-rate data you track yourself

Analysis and Business Case Development

  • Analyze outreach and conversion data to identify what's working and quantify results (contacts made, response rates, conversion rates)
  • Turn merchant feedback into structured insight that could inform Nearby.ai's value proposition or onboarding process
  • Build a simple business case (expected partners signed, revenue impact) to justify where to focus next

Solutioning and Partnership Development

  • Independently draft outreach scripts, pitch decks, and partnership proposals tailored to each merchant type
  • Lead onboarding conversations through to close
  • Recommend improvements to the onboarding process based on what you hear from merchants

Reporting and Recommendations

  • Report weekly on outreach metrics and pipeline, framed as insights and next steps, not just raw counts
  • Deliver a final presentation to the team: your market analysis, results, and a recommended go-forward strategy for merchant acquisition

Who You Are

  • Currently pursuing an MBA (or equivalent graduate business program), ideally with prior experience in consulting, sales, BD, or a startup
  • Comfortable being fully self-directed — you build the plan, not just execute someone else's
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills; genuinely comfortable working in spreadsheets and data
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to cold-call and negotiate with small-business owners
  • High tolerance for ambiguity and rejection — energized by 0-to-1, hands-on work

Details

  • Type: Internship, 20–40 hrs/week
  • Duration: 3–6 months
  • Location: Remote
  • Compensation: Paid, $40-60 hourly

Why Join Nearby.ai

  • Own a real merchant-acquisition initiative from research through close — a rare level of end-to-end ownership for an internship
  • Learn the full cycle of partnership development at an early-stage company where your work directly impacts growth
  • Build a portfolio of quantified business impact (partners signed, pipeline built, market analysis delivered) — highly relevant for post-MBA BD, strategy, or general management roles
  • Potential to convert to a full-time role based on performance

ABOUT PER SCHOLAS:

For 30 years, Per Scholas has been on a mission to drive mobility and opportunity in the ever-advancing technology landscape by unlocking the untapped potential of individuals, uplifting communities, and meeting the needs of employers through rigorous tech training. By teaming up with dynamic employer partners, ranging from Fortune 500 companies to innovative startups, we're forging inclusive tech talent pipelines, fulfilling an ever-increasing need for skilled talent. With national remote training and campuses in 20+ cities and counting, Per Scholas offers no-cost training programs in the most sought-after tech skills, spanning Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data Engineering, IT Support, Software Engineering, and more. To date, 30,000+ individuals have been trained through Per Scholas, propelling their professional trajectories into high-growth tech careers with salaries three times higher than their pre-training earnings. Learn more by visiting PerScholas.org and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

Per Scholas preferred hires reside within the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, MD, MA, MI, MO, NC, NJ, NY, OH, PA, TX, WA

Job Description: Technical Support and Office Assistant Intern

Location: Seattle Campus (Downtown Seattle - 2101 4th Ave, Seattle, WA 98121)

Reports To: Managing Director

Position Overview

Per Scholas Seattle is seeking a motivated, adaptable, and enthusiastic Technical Support and Office Assistant Intern to join our team. While this role places a strong emphasis on hands-on IT support and hardware/software troubleshooting, it is uniquely designed to expose the candidate to the full scope of operating a workforce development non-profit.

As an intern, no two days will be the same! You will work very closely with our local campus leadership team—supporting classroom tech operations, recruitment, professional development, talent solutions, and daily site management. You’ll be exposed to various facets of nonprofit program management engaged in a wide range of tasks and projects.   Whether you are looking to launch an IT career or step into the non-profit sector, this role provides invaluable, multi-faceted experience, executive exposure, and high-impact skill-building opportunities.

Key Responsibilities & Tasks

Technical Support & Classroom Operations

  • Hardware & Software Maintenance: Troubleshoot, configure, secure, and maintain campus hardware—including workstations, laptops, and break-and-fix units—for staff and learners.
  • Classroom Assistance: Serve as a backup for classroom management, assist with taking attendance, check in with absent learners, and provide direct technical support.
  • Curriculum & Alumni Support: Offer technical guidance and support to learners navigating the IT Support curriculum.

Recruitment & Admissions

  • Outreach: Support community outreach and represent Per Scholas at offsite recruitment events as needed.
  • Data Management: Assist with data cleanup and maintenance within our Salesforce database.
  • Device Management: Act as dedicated technical support for loaned learner laptops.

Professional Development & Alumni Engagement

  • Career Resources: Organize resume templates, interview guides, networking materials, job-search tools, LinkedIn resources, and AI prompt libraries. Review and flag outdated materials.
  • Event & Community Tracking: Build and maintain an updated list of Seattle-area tech events, networking opportunities, and career programming.
  • Classroom Engagement: Track learner participation and assist with Professional Development sessions.
  • Graduation Support: Help prepare presentation decks, gather learner graduation statements, and assist with campus graduation ceremony setup.

Talent Solutions & Employer Partnerships

  • Employer Outreach: Conduct outreach via phone and email to introduce potential employer partners to Per Scholas and gauge hiring interest.
  • Engagement Events: Assist in coordinating mock interviews, employer panels, and networking events.

Site & Campus Management

  • Facility Operations: Monitor inventory for kitchen and food supplies, manage daily kitchenette cleanup (including dishwasher operation and dish storage), and keep shared areas organized.
  • Event & Catering Logistics: Assist with overall campus event logistics, including ordering and setting up catering for office events and strategic meetings.

Critical Skills & Qualifications

  • CRM & Tech Tools: Practical understanding of Salesforce (or other CRMs) and proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Drive, Meet, Slides).
  • Communication & Presentation: Solid verbal and written communication skills with the comfort level to speak with business executives and diverse audiences.
  • Technical Passion: Genuine enthusiasm for technology and hands-on hardware/software troubleshooting.
  • Core Soft Skills: High achievement mindset, exceptional project management, strong follow-up habits, and detail-oriented time

Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

This working student position is designed for individuals who are interested in applying technology to solve real customer challenges while growing into customer-facing technical professionals. Working alongside our Solutions Architects, you will support the discovery, design, piloting, and delivery of geospatial solutions by combining your technical background with Planet’s products and platforms. You will collaborate directly with customers, engineers, and cross-functional teams, progressively developing the technical and consulting skills required to become a trusted technical advisor.

This is a part-time (20 hours/week), hybrid role which will require you to work from our Berlin office approximately 2 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Support Solutions Architects in customer discovery, solution design, pilot delivery, and customer adoption.
  • Participate in customer workshops by gathering requirements, documenting outcomes, coordinating follow-up actions, and supporting Agile solution delivery.
  • Act as the technical communication bridge for Russian-speaking customers throughout workshops, pilots, and ongoing engagements.
  • Prepare customer datasets, subscriptions, collections, and Planet platform resources for demonstrations and pilot projects.
  • Support engineers and architects with solution validation, testing, technical troubleshooting, and customer onboarding.
  • Contribute to pre-sales activities, customer demonstrations, technical training, and regional onsite engagements.

What You Bring:

  • Currently enrolled full-time at an accredited university in GIS, Computer Science, Remote Sensing, Geography, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with GIS software such as QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, ENVI, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience supporting customer workshops, gathering requirements, and working directly with end users.
  • Experience using AI tools for productivity, coding, and rapid prototyping.
  • Solid communication skills with the ability to collaborate directly with customers and technical teams.
  • Fluent written and spoken Russian and English.
  • A proactive, curious, and customer-oriented mindset.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • A background in remote sensing, geoscience, or geoinformatics.
  • Practical experience with Python for geospatial applications, data processing, or automation.
  • Experience designing geospatial solutions or supporting solution architecture.
  • Experience with Agile software development and cross-functional product delivery.
  • Experience with machine learning, modern cloud technologies, CI/CD, or geospatial web applications.
  • Familiarity with Planet products or Earth observation technologies.

The Role 

We are excited to offer an internship opportunity for a talented student to join the data science team at Schonfeld. The data science team is responsible for creating Schonfeld's proprietary curated and feature datasets, conducting data analytics and research, and ultimately add value to various investment strategies. 

What You’ll Do   

As a data scientist, you will work closely with the engineering teams to optimize data ingestion pipelines, ensuring high-quality data input. You will also collaborate with portfolio manager teams to extract insights from data and systematically generate features or signals that feed into the alpha generation process. Additionally, you will develop domain expertise across various financial asset classes and datasets, produce curated datasets to standardize research, conduct quantitative analysis to generate ideas and validate hypothesis through backtesting. The ideal candidate will possess both a passion for data science disciplines and a strong interest in financial markets. 

What You’ll Bring 

What you need:  

  • Knowledge of Python, SQL, or other programming languages
  • Proficiency with statistical and machine learning packages for quantitative analysis
  • Experience researching and analyzing financial datasets
  • Attention to detail and strong communication skills
  • Degree in quantitative field such as computer science, data science or financial engineering 

 

We’d love if you had:  

  • Strong passion for financial markets and related datasets
  • Knowledge of deep learning models
  • Familiarity with AI tools to accelerate work, with a focus on adding analysis and insight
  • Experience with any of the following technologies: Spark, Kafka, Docker, Airflow
  • Knowledge of financial asset classes such as equity, futures, and fixed Income

 

Our Internship 

Kick-start your career in finance with the Schonfeld Summer Internship! Over the course of 10 action-packed weeks, you will have the opportunity to build solutions that tackle real-world challenges and leave a lasting impact on the firm. As an intern, you’ll join a close-knit team that is ready to support your growth and accelerate your career. We will pair you with a dedicated manager and a mentor who’ll guide your development over the course of the internship and beyond. Throughout the program, you will have the chance to connect with senior leaders through a series of learning sessions, attend hands-on skills workshops, network at social events and get a behind-the-scenes look at how various functions power the firm. We’ll empower you to bring your ideas to life and make an impact.  

Who We Are   

Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income. 

Our Culture  

At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.

The Role  

We are seeking a highly qualified DMFI Risk Analyst Summer Intern to join our DMFI Risk team in London. This team is responsible for helping management and portfolio managers within DMFI (Discretionary Macro Fixed Income) think about different dimensions of risk.  

What You’ll Do  

As a DMFI Risk Analyst Summer Intern, you’ll spend ten weeks with the Schonfeld DMFI Risk team, focusing on quantitative risk research and tool development for analysis of our portfolio’s exposures to market moves, particularly macro-economic and geo-political shocks. The research project will involve the use of advanced quantitative techniques and economic theory. The results of the research project and their insights will inform the implementation of a python-based tool to be integrated into our team's BAU. 

What You’ll Bring 

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative or technical field such as mathematics, physics, engineering, economics, or finance (ideally with one year left in your academic program) 
  • Knowledge of, and coursework in, finance, linear algebra, statistics and data science 
  • Proficient programming ability in Python 
  • Proficient Agentic (AI) coding ability 
  • Knowledge of databases like SQL and/or KDB 
  • Excellent organizational skills and high regard for attention to detail
  • Strong problem-solving skills 
  • A passion for financial markets and a desire to learn more about the strategies deployed by hedge funds 

Our Internship 

Kick-start your career in finance with the Schonfeld Summer Internship! Over the course of 10 action-packed weeks, you will have the opportunity to build solutions that tackle real-world challenges and leave a lasting impact on the firm. As an intern, you’ll join a close-knit team that is ready to support your growth and accelerate your career. We will pair you with a dedicated manager and a mentor who’ll guide your development over the course of the internship and beyond. Throughout the program, you will have the chance to connect with senior leaders through a series of learning sessions, attend hands-on skills workshops, network at social events and get a behind-the-scenes look at how various functions power the firm. We’ll empower you to bring your ideas to life and make an impact.  

Who We Are 

Schonfeld is a global multi-manager hedge fund that strives to deliver industry-leading risk-adjusted returns for our investors. We leverage both internal and external portfolio manager teams around the world, seeking to capitalize on inefficiencies and opportunities within the markets. We draw from decades of experience and a significant investment in proprietary technology, infrastructure and risk analytics to invest across four main strategies: Quant, Tactical, Fundamental Equity and Discretionary Macro & Fixed Income. 

Our Culture 

At Schonfeld, we’ll invest in you. Attracting and retaining top talent is at the heart of what we do, because we believe that exceptional outcomes begin with exceptional people. We foster a culture where talent is empowered to continually learn, innovate and pursue ambitious goals. We are teamwork-oriented, collaborative and encourage ideas—at all levels—to be shared. As an organization committed to investing in our people, we provide learning and educational offerings and opportunities to make an impact. We encourage community through internal networks, external partnerships and service initiatives that promote inclusion and purpose beyond the firm’s walls.

Chart Your Journey at Secretariat

From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat.

 

ABOUT THE FIRM

Secretariat is a consulting firm that helps companies, law firms, and organizations solve complex business problems—often when there is a dispute, investigation, major project challenge, or high-stakes decision involved. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world.

From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions.

Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives.

Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat.

ABOUT Our Damages & Valuations team

Our Damages & Valuations team sits at the intersection of finance, data, strategy, and the law. We help clients answer high-stakes questions when businesses, investors, and legal teams need to understand what something is worth, how much money may have been lost, and what the financial evidence really shows. Our work supports complex disputes, arbitration matters, and business challenges around the world—giving team members exposure to real-world problems where their analysis can directly influence important decisions.

As part of this team, you will collaborate with accountants, economists, PhDs, business valuation experts, investment analysts, and industry specialists to investigate complex issues, analyze data, and translate financial information into clear, persuasive insights. It is challenging, fast-moving work that helps early-career professionals build consulting skills quickly, learn from recognized experts, and see how their work connects to major business and legal outcomes. The team’s work is highly regarded: Secretariat was ranked #1 in Global Arbitration Review’s Expert Witness Firm Power Index in 2024 and 2025, and more than 90% of our testifying experts are recognized as leading experts by Who's Who Legal.

RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will be part of a growing domestic and international practice where strong analytical thinking, curiosity, creativity, and clear communication are essential. Associates are actively involved in meaningful project work from the start—helping the team uncover facts, analyze financial information, and develop insights that support high-stakes client matters.

  • Dig into case documents, research materials, and discovery records to understand the facts behind complex disputes
  • Analyze financial statements, business records, market data, and other evidence to help quantify damages and support valuation work
  • Build models, organize data, and develop analyses that help explain financial issues clearly and accurately
  • Contribute to reports, presentations, and client-ready materials that turn detailed analysis into compelling insights
  • Work closely with senior consultants and experts, gaining hands-on experience in litigation support, valuation, damages analysis, and economic consulting

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving puzzles, working with numbers, asking thoughtful questions, and learning how financial analysis can make a real impact in business and legal settings. The ideal candidate is coachable, intellectually curious, detail-oriented, and excited to grow in a collaborative consulting environment.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently pursuing bachelor’s or master’s degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or another analytically rigorous discipline from an accredited college or university
  • Expected graduation date between December 2027 and August 2028
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn new concepts and ask thoughtful questions
  • Interest or experience in economic consulting, litigation support, valuation, damages analysis, finance, accounting, data analysis, or other research-intensive work
  • Experience with research projects, undergraduate theses, consulting internships, data analytics internships, finance-related work, or similar experiences that demonstrate ownership of complex work
  • Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with tools such as Stata, R, Python, or SQL is helpful, along with an eagerness to continue building technical skills
  • Comfort working with data, conducting research, organizing information clearly, and using emerging tools, including AI, to improve efficiency, quality, and analytical rigor
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to balance multiple assignments and communicate proactively
  • Ability to stay focused, adaptable, and solutions-oriented when priorities shift or deadlines are tight
  • Clear listening, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex information in a thoughtful and professional way; fluency in English for business communication is required
  • Interest in professional development or credentials such as C

description:
Chart Your Journey at Secretariat

From a collaborative culture to teammates who will always be by your side, find a career that will grow with you. Deliver your impact at Secretariat.

 

ABOUT THE FIRM

Secretariat is a consulting firm that helps companies, law firms, and organizations solve complex business problems—often when there is a dispute, investigation, major project challenge, or high-stakes decision involved. At Secretariat, you’ll work on some of the most important legal, risk, and regulatory challenges facing businesses around the world.

From your first day, you’ll be part of a fast-growing team of smart, curious, and driven people who enjoy solving complex problems. You’ll learn by working alongside experienced professionals and contributing to projects for leading law firms, global companies, and major institutions.

Our teams collaborate across offices and disciplines, bringing energy, fresh thinking, and commitment to every client challenge. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, mentorship, professional development, recognition, and a culture that values diverse perspectives.

Start your career where your work matters. Make your impact at Secretariat.

ABOUT Our Damages & Valuations team

Our Damages & Valuations team sits at the intersection of finance, data, strategy, and the law. We help clients answer high-stakes questions when businesses, investors, and legal teams need to understand what something is worth, how much money may have been lost, and what the financial evidence really shows. Our work supports complex disputes, arbitration matters, and business challenges around the world—giving team members exposure to real-world problems where their analysis can directly influence important decisions.

As part of this team, you will collaborate with accountants, economists, PhDs, business valuation experts, investment analysts, and industry specialists to investigate complex issues, analyze data, and translate financial information into clear, persuasive insights. It is challenging, fast-moving work that helps early-career professionals build consulting skills quickly, learn from recognized experts, and see how their work connects to major business and legal outcomes. The team’s work is highly regarded: Secretariat was ranked #1 in Global Arbitration Review’s Expert Witness Firm Power Index in 2024 and 2025, and more than 90% of our testifying experts are recognized as leading experts by Who's Who Legal.

RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, you will be part of a growing domestic and international practice where strong analytical thinking, curiosity, creativity, and clear communication are essential. Associates are actively involved in meaningful project work from the start—helping the team uncover facts, analyze financial information, and develop insights that support high-stakes client matters.

  • Dig into case documents, research materials, and discovery records to understand the facts behind complex disputes

The ideal candidate is coachable, intellectually curious, detail-oriented, and excited to grow in a collaborative consulting environment.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

What you’ll do

As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous engineers in the industry and learn how to ship high-quality work at scale. By contributing to Stripe’s codebase you’ll work across domains that give you insight into how the global economy works. Recent intern projects include expanding Stripe’s Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.

Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. 

Responsibilities

  • Operate as a real member of the team you join; engage in team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.
  • Write software that will be used in production, and has meaningful impact to Stripe’s business and users.
  • Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions
  • Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback.
  • Learn quickly by asking great questions, working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, communicating the status of your work clearly, and building with the latest AI tooling.

Who you are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

  • A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, math, or a related discipline. 
  • Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
  • Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts. 
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

  • At least 1 year of university education, or equivalent work experience.
  • One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledg

description:
At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business. A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.

Join us and grow your recruiting career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

What You'll Do:

You will play a key role in scaling our Fleet Operations, Commercial Strategy, and Corporate teams, while also supporting our internship and co-op hiring programs. This role will perform all duties of a full life cycle Recruiter, with the flexibility to flex into entry level technology hiring based on business need. Other job-related responsibilities include:

  • Owning full life cycle recruitment for Fleet Operations, Commercial Strategy, and Corporate roles, from sourcing and screening through offer and close, ensuring an outstanding candidate experience
  • Sourcing passive candidates for tough-to-fill and niche roles, including frontline and operations talent
  • Supporting Torc's internship and co-op programs, including sourcing, campus partnerships, and coordinating the candidate experience for early career talent
  • Partnering with hiring teams to set recruiting strategy and achieve annual hiring goals across assigned functions
  • Networking online and offline to promote our employer brand, reduce time-to-hire, and build a strong talent pipeline for current and future positions
  • Flexing into entry level technology recruiting support as business needs shift
  • Partnering with dedicated recruiting coordinators to schedule and coordinate interviews
  • Maintaining and updating all pertinent applicant and interview data in the applicant tracking system
  • Consulting with hiring managers on job postings to accurately reflect role responsibilities

What You'll Need to Succeed:

  • 4+ years of full life cycle recruiting experience, ideally including experience recruiting for operations, fleet, logistics, or frontline/hourly/shift roles
  • Experience supporting corporate function hiring (e.g. Finance, People, Legal, Marketing) preferred
  • Experience with internship or co-op recruiting programs a plus
  • Existing network within operations, fleet, or logistics talent communities a plus
  • Solid background using direct sourcing strategies to build pipelines, including LinkedIn Recruiter
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain productive partnerships with hiring managers and leaders
  • Comfortable managing a diverse requisition load across multiple functions at once
  • Experience with applicant tracking systems (ATS), Greenhouse preferred
  • Ability to travel approximately 10-15% for hiring events, career fairs, and building partnerships with trade schools, colleges, and community organizations that support hiring pipelines
  • Valid driver's license and ability to obtain a passport for team offsites
  • Effective communication skills, with a habit of proactively keeping stakeholders informed

Work Location: For the ideal candidate, we are open to Remote based in the US. Working in a hybrid capacity at our Blacksburg, VA or Fort Worth, TX office location would be preferred. Relocation support is available.

Perks of Being a Full-time Torc'r

Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

  • A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options
  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
  • 401K plan with a 6% employer match
  • Flexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)
  • Company-wide holiday office closures
  • AD+D and Life Insurance

At Torc, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc'rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities.

Even if you don't meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Torc's total compensation package will also include our corporate bonus and stock option plan. Dependent on the position offered, sign-on payments, relocation, and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

  • Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
  • What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
  • It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

YOUR MISSION

Seeking an entry-level Apprentice Spacecraft Technician who can be utilized across the production shop based on workload and program needs, with primary support focused on Mechanical Production, Spacecraft Integration, and Test. This role is intended to develop an individual with limited industry experience into a well-rounded spacecraft technician through hands-on training and cross-functional exposure.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

•    Support spacecraft mechanical assembly and integration.
•    Assist with installation and removal of spacecraft components and flight hardware.
•    Perform basic mechanical operations such as fastening, torquing, taping, and hardware installation after appropriate training.
•    Support spacecraft and component test setup and execution.
•    Assist with environmental and functional test activities as trained and qualified.
•    Read and follow work instructions, procedures, drawings, and manufacturing documentation.
•    Learn proper use of hand tools, power tools, torque tools, measuring equipment, and production equipment.
•    Support hardware movement, material handling, shop organization, and general production needs.
•    Maintain FOD, ESD, cleanliness, safety, and hardware-handling standards.
•    Document completed work and communicate discrepancies or issues to technicians, leads, engineers, and management.
•    Cross-train in multiple production and test functions.
•    Flex between work areas as production priorities and staffing needs change.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

•    High school diploma or equivalent.
•    0–1 year of manufacturing, mechanical, technical, automotive, aerospace, or similar hands-on experience.
•    Basic mechanical aptitude.
•    Comfortable learning and working with hand and power tools.
•    Ability to follow detailed written and verbal instructions.
•    Strong attention to detail.
•    Reliable and willing to work as part of a team.
•    Strong willingness to learn new skills and take on new responsibilities.
•    Ability to work in multiple areas of the production shop as needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

•    Trade school, technical school, automotive, manufacturing, mechanical, aviation, electronics, or similar hands-on experience.
•    Exposure to engineering drawings or work instructions.
•    Basic experience with torque tools or measurement equipment.
•    Previous experience in a manufacturing or production environment.
•    Interest in spacecraft manufacturing, integration, and testing.


IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate does not need previous aerospace experience. We are looking for someone who is:
•    Mechanically inclined and enjoys hands-on work.
•    Curious and eager to learn.
•    Dependable and willing to take direction.
•    Comfortable asking questions.
•    Detail-oriented and quality focused.
•    Flexible and willing to support wherever the team needs help.
•    Interested in developing into a well-rounded spacecraft technician.

COMPENSATION

  • Base Salary:  
    • Technician- $22-34/hr

description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast offers an advanced engineering internship program with hands-on opportunities to design and build space hardware and software. You will play a crucial role in the development of the systems that will be required for the operation of human-rated space stations and space infrastructure. We have five engineering internship postings for different areas of focus. Please only apply to the most relevant posting for your background.

Our interns are mentored by industry experts to solve challenging real-world engineering problems across our hiring teams. This is a 12 week internship at our offices in Long Beach, CA or Hawthorne, CA or Mojave, CA.

Responsibilities will vary depending on each intern’s area of expertise. We are currently looking for candidates with experience in the the following engineering disciplines:

  • ECLSS (Environmental Control & Life Support Systems)
  • ECLSS Test
  • E-2 
  • Propulsion
  • Propulsion Test
  • Solar
  • Structures Design
  • Structures Test
  • Thermal Analysis
  • Thermal Hardware
  • Thermal Test

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Qualified candidates must be enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master’s degree program from an accredited college or university in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other related engineering discipline.
  • Ability to work full-time onsite in Long Beach, Hawthorne, and Mojave, CA.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Application of technical skills outside of the classroom (examples include: extracurricular projects, volunteering, personal projects, laboratory research, or prior internship/work experience)
  • Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, CATIA) for 3D modeling and simulation
  • Attention to detail 
  • Strong engineering problem solving capabilities
  • Basic knowledge of engineering and equipment
  • Prior knowledge of analysis tools
  • Ability to collaborate across different teams
  • Self-directed with a positive attitude and team spirit
Pay Range: California
$35—$42 USD

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

 

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the Role:

As an Engineering Intern at Vercel, you will be an important part of our engineering team, working on real projects that will impact our products and customers. You will be mentored by experienced engineers and will be given opportunities to grow and learn.

 

What You Will Do:

Work will vary by team - but your general scope will include, but not be limited to:

  • Own an end-to-end project: scope it with your manager, build it, ship it, and see it in customers' hands.
  • Write and review production code alongside the engineers who maintain it.
  • Debug real systems under real conditions - trace an issue through the stack and fix the root cause.
  • Communicate your progress clearly, including when you're blocked.

 

About You:

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, graduating December 2027 or May 2028.
  • Strong knowledge and capability with JavaScript and/or TypeScript. Experience with Go or Rust is a bonus.
  • You dig into problems rather than around them - you want to know why something broke.
  • You move work forward on your own. You surface blockers early instead of waiting to be asked.
  • You communicate well in writing. Much of how we work is asynchronous and written down.
  • Fluent with AI tooling and clear-eyed about it. You use it to move faster, and you can still explain, defend, and debug everything you ship.
  • Based in San Francisco, willing and able to commute Mon/Tues/Fri.

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $110,000 - $132,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. 

Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

Ready to dive into the world of smart tech and help build the future of IoT? As a Technical Support Engineering Intern, you won't be grabbing coffee or shadowing others. Our interns are at the forefront of our team, tackling real-world challenges alongside our full-time engineers. Based at our San Mateo HQ, you'll work with cutting-edge, cloud-managed IoT technology, helping our enterprise clients with everything from troubleshooting to system design.

This internship is your chance to make a real impact, build valuable technical skills, and jumpstart your career in a dynamic, high-tech environment.

What You'll Do

  • Hands-on Troubleshooting: Dive into complex network, hardware, and software problems on Verkada's platform
  • Level Up Fast: Become the go-to expert customers trust for smart system design and integration advice
  • Communicate with Impact: Translate heavy technical concepts into clear, sharp advice on phone calls, live chat, and emails 
  • Own It, End to End: Take full ownership of customer issues from "we have a problem" to "problem solved"
  • Team Up with Tech Leaders: Partner directly with Engineering and Product teams to test new gear and hunt down bugs before anyone else
  • Share Knowledge: Write Knowledge Base content that helps thousands of users

What You Bring

  • Available for a full-time (40 hours per week) in-person internship for Spring 2027 in San Mateo, CA
  • A third or fourth-year student in a Bachelor's degree program from an accredited university, with a focus on a related technical field like Networking, Telecommunications, Systems Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Cybersecurity
  • You have coursework experience with computer networking, Linux, and computer systems
  • You're a problem-solver with a keen eye for detail
  • You can clearly and confidently communicate complex technical information
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • Industry certifications (like CCNP, CCNA, or Network+) are a bonus, but not required!

Intern Perks & Benefits

At Verkada, we believe that internships should be as rewarding, supportive, and fun as they are impactful! That’s why we’re committed to providing a world-class experience that supports both your personal well-being and professional growth. Here are just a few of the perks and benefits you can expect as a Verkada Technical Support Engineering intern:
  • Monthly housing stipend for those relocating to the area, in addition to a competitive hourly wage 
  • Daily lunch catered onsite, complimentary barista-made drinks, and fully stocked snacks to keep you fueled 
  • Intern-exclusive events and mixers, allowing you to connect with other interns across different teams 
  • Cross-functional collaboration opportunities, giving you real exposure to how teams work together
  • Meetings with company executives so you can hear directly from leaders and gain insight into building a successful career 
  • 333 program: you can go out with your fellow interns after work and expense $30 off a meal
  • Friendly tournaments involving Super Smash Bros, Magic, and other games
  • Intern exclusive bingo cards that allow you to explore the Bay Area and win fun swag!
  • And more! From team-building activities to mentorship opportunities, we’re here to support your growth every step of the way

Don't just take it from us, hear directly from some of our current and past interns on their experience: 

  • “A benefit of being a TSE at Verkada is about being a part of a fast-growing company. You learn about the latest products deeply and learn how to effectively communicate what you have learned in an easy-to-understand way for customers: ‘If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it well enough.’ Albert Einstein” - Daniel, TSE Intern, Lon

description:
Visier is the global leader in Workforce Intelligence that powers every people decision. We bring Workforce AI to life for HR departments through our award-winning, agentic AI technology by surfacing the insights leaders need to plan, decide, and act with confidence in the moments that matter most. As the market leader in people analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, and manager effectiveness solutions, we fuel smarter decision-making for organizations across the globe. Our mission is to help businesses lead with insight at scale as they continuously transform.

Founded in 2010 by the pioneers of business intelligence, we have over 85,000 customers in 75 countries—including enterprises like BASF, Panasonic, Domino’s Pizza, Experian, Amgen, eBay, and Ford Motor Company.

Our co-op experience is unique and designed to prepare you for professional success as you work on real, impactful work from the beginning...not features that may be mothballed after 8 months of hard work! Our ultimate goal is to give you the mentorship, training, and work experience you need to start your career. A number of our students return to us after they graduate and start developing their professional career at Visier!

And we use state-of-the-art technology to build our innovative full-stack software solution that helps people see the truth and drives organizations to perform their best. We use a variety of frontend technologies including Angular, NgRx, Play Framework, TypeScript, Less, and others. We deal with large volumes of data every day. And in our backend areas we work with technologies like Scala, Kafka, Consul, Cassandra DB, Docker, AWS, etc. So, you’ll be developing knowledge and skills that are transferable anywhere.

What you'll be doing...

  • Writing production-level code that will directly impact customers
  • Implementing cool new features
  • Fixing complex bugs
  • Collaborating with people in all stages of the software development cycle

What you'll bring to the table...

  • Coding skills in relevant programming languages (for example, like Java, JavaScript, Typescript, Scala or other similar languages)
  • Coding skills in writing functional tests (eg using Selenium and ScalaTest)
  • Knowledge of data structures and algorithms
  • Attention to detail, tendency to spot mistakes and identify potential improvements
  • Knowledge of web technologies (REST, HTML/CSS, JSON, Angular) is an advantage
  • Knowledge of relational and non-relational databases and SQL language

🌱 What do we value...

  • You roll up your sleeves
  • You make it easy
  • You are proud
  • You never stop learning
  • You play to win

🚀 How we work & what we offer...

  • Fixed hybrid work model: 3 days a week in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday)
  • Modern, pet-friendly downtown office spaces with collaborative areas and an on-site gym

The base pay range for this position in Canada is $3,600 - $4,500 per month.

Benefits and working arrangements may vary depending on your seniority, location and employment type. The compensation offered will be determined by factors such as relevant qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. Many of our positions are eligible for additional types of compensation (e.g., commission plans, bonus, etc.) which our Talent Acquisition team will share with you if you interview for the role.

Through rigorous analysis and practical implementation strategies, FREOPP develops durable policy solutions across healthcare, welfare reform, child welfare, housing, K–12, higher education, and more that expand opportunity and strengthen individual agency.

description: The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. General Information Pacific Legal Foundation identifies and litigates important legal issues to set landmark precedents that benefit Americans nationwide. Using strategic and principled litigation, communications, and research, PLF battles for freedom in the nation’s courts and the court of public opinion. As a national nonprofit organization, PLF has brick-and-mortar offices in Sacramento, California; Arlington, Virginia; and Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, although approximately half of the staff work from home offices across the country. Interns work remotely by default, but they can request to work physically in any of PLF’s offices. This is a part-time role. You: An inquisitive, creative, and self-motivated college junior, senior, grad student, or recent graduate who knows the principles of liberty and seeks to advance them. You have strong written and oral communication skills and enjoy problem solving. Them: Bureaucrats, city councils, mayors, governors, and federal agencies stripping Americans of their rights every day. There’s a lot of government overreach out there, and it’s backed by seemingly endless resources. Us: We fight back. Pacific Legal Foundation (PLF) is the nation’s first and most successful public interest law firm dedicated to vindicating individual liberty. PLF has an unmatched record in the US Supreme Court, with 18 victories out of 20 cases heard by the Court. PLF also has nearly 200 active cases across the nation. At PLF, we aren’t interested in doing the same thing as everyone else. We aspire to be the best player in a constantly changing game. The Strategic Research intern will be a member of the Strategic Research team. This team produces high-quality social science research to support PLF’s mission-driven goals. The team coordinates with PLF’s Litigation, Legal Policy, Constitutional Scholarship, and Communications teams. This internship is an opportunity for a wide variety of experiences, including the following: · Communicating with public officials to obtain public records. · Collecting, organizing, and analyzing data using Microsoft Excel, R, Python, GIS, or Stata. · Conducting literature reviews on such topics as regulatory reform, housing supply, property rights, coastal land rights, and more. · Developing internal data for litigation, communications, or legal policy campaigns. · Writing blog posts, op-eds, or one-pagers on topics relevant to PLF’s work. How to Apply If you think you might be a good fit, submit the following application materials in ONE PDF when you upload your résumé that includes relevant experience in the liberty movement and professional skills: · A cover letter explaining why PLF is the place for you, why you want to fight for liberty, and what distinguishes you from typical applicants. · A writing sample. · A semester schedule (if taking classes during the internship period).
